title: Best Shopify Alternatives: When You Need a Site, Not a Store
summary: Six Shopify alternatives compared on the real fee stack, app costs and site control. Every price read from the vendor's own page and dated August 2026.
body_markdown: It is a fee Shopify charges on every sale when you use a gateway other than Shopify Payments — 2% on Basic, 1% on Grow, 0.6% on Advanced, 0.2% on Plus — on top of what that gateway charges. Avoid it with Shopify Payments, or by climbing the plan ladder. Wix is reported to charge 0% on every plan, though that figure is third-party-sourced rather than read from Wix's own fee page.
